I think there were about five or six in the first cluster we saw. One would light up really bright just like a ball of fire, then as it was going out after 1 second or so the next would light up, so on and so forth. We tried to capture what we were seeing via our cell phones, as we didn't have a camera on hand, but we were to far away for our cameras to capture the oval-shaped object.

When I looked over at the mountain over the mountain there was a very faint star and then a upside down triangle appeared as faintly as the star, but it was bright enough I could tell the shape. The stars were in the shape of an upside down triangle. Then it faded out and disappeared. It would fade in and out.
It then changed shape into a big cluster of stars when it faded back in. Then faded out. Then changed again to the triangle shape when it faded back in.
There was a moment that there looked like a blue orb like something had exploded. It did not look like I was seeing something in our atmosphere I felt like I was watching a war in space.
I tried to wake my boyfriend up to show him, but his eyes wouldn’t focus and he went back to bed.
I sat and watched it for about 5 more minutes and then went back to bed.
When I woke up at 3am a couple hours later there was nothing there. All was faded out and did not fade back in. Even the faded star that stayed in the sky during the hole episode.
The sky’s have been too cloudy to see since then.

As I stared at it, it got brighter and brighter, it was a first orange. All the sudden as I’m watching it, it’s as if someone turned off a light. It just went out and never showed back up again. It lasted a good 10 minutes. I watched it for awhile. It moved slightly but mostly remained still in one place high in the sky. I’m no stranger to sightings.

It was rather diamond shaped, with the light fading behind the back corner. This ‘corner’ didn’t actually touch, but seemed to trail behind. Inside these two trails was a small second light. Easily 1/16 the size of the large light, maybe smaller. 
As I drove North on Highway 321 from Dayton, I noticed this light shooting through the sky. I saw it from the top of my windshield to maybe halfway down the windshields which point it vanished. I thought it had maybe gone behind a tree I couldn’t see in the dark. But after driving further, there was no tree in the area. The light moved fast. When it went it did not fade or slowly disappear, it was just gone as if someone had turned off the switch. I do not know ! what I saw. But I know that I have never seen anything like it before.

summary: Dark Triangle Spotted in Cloud Cover on I-287 Near Morristown, NJ
description:
The event occurred traveling northbound on interstate 287 between Basking Ridge and Morristown. Visibility was good at street level but the sky was opaque with low lying cloud cover. 
At approximate 7:30am EST, a dark triangle moved through my field of vision on a westerly trajectory, through the clouds, disturbing the cloud around it as it traveled like a hand through smoke. I could not get a definitive view as it was using the cloud cover. All that was visible was its triangular shape and that it was black or very dark grey. It was silent, had no lights and was moving at a fast rate of speed. Viewing lasted for about 4 seconds. My best estimate is that the object was about a half a mile downrange and maybe 200-300 feet above the ground, Just high enough to use the cloud cover. Considering the distance and size of the object in my field of view my best guess is that it was about 100' from edge to edge. Morristown does have a small airport, but whatever this was, it just didn't look like a plane or anything you would normally see.

summary: I was standing outside of my car in Brookshire, Texas, at approximately 6:34 PM on Saturday, January 6th.  I happened to be looking towards the east when I saw this bright orange light rise up over…
description:
It rose straight up and then proceeded to travel to the West/Northwest at about the speed of a news helicopter. Since this was a Saturday I knew it was not a news helicopter or any other chopper for that matter. They are rare in this isolated area.
At first I assumed it was small drone. However, having experience with flying drones, I expected the familiar drone sound but the light/object was completely silent. Drones are very noisy. It flew right over me. It was probably about 300 feet in the air but it was hard to tell given that it was very dark, although the sun had just set.
The light was colored between orange and yellow. Size was difficult to determine as it was just a ball of light. I could not really make out a shape or form. I thought about running inside for my binoculars but did not do so because the object would have been gone by the time of my return.
The entire sighting lasted about 60 seconds.
The weather was clear and very little breeze. There was the faintest hint of the setting sun but it was still very dark, almost night time. There was no alcohol or other mind altering substances involved.

summary: I assumed the huge ball of light shooting across the atmosphere was a shooting star, until it stopped abruptly. - Cumming, GA
description:
Around 4:20am, I was headed north on GA400 towards my home. As I passed Exit 13, I noticed what appeared to be a shooting star. It was just a large ball of white light literally moving at lightening speed across the sky. So my first reaction was to make a wish, but as I'm watching it shoot across the horizon, it didn't disappear. It literally came to an abrupt stop, which completely startled me. 
Then right before me on the highway I then saw what appeared to be an aircraft of some kind, hovering ahead of me. It had red and blue flashing lights...I really couldn't make out a shape...and thats when it registered that this was definitely something else out of the ordinary. A few seconds later, it shot off into atmosphere at lightening speed and disappeared. 
Both objects moved entirely too fast to be anything logical such as a plane or a helicopter, or even a drone. In addition, the ball of light traveling lightening speed across the atmosphere and completely stopping, with a random hovering object then appearing...no explanation. Absolutely no explanation. 
This weirded me out enough to actually want to report it.

summary: A strange orb appeared to be following my car.
description:
I was by myself driving from Shoshoni to Riverton. The sun had gone down a couple hours earlier and it was cloudy, so it was a very dark night. The roads were icy so my attention was very firmly on the road.
Out of the corner of my eye I saw a light to the right of my car. I turned my head and looked at it. About 20 feet to the right of my car was a glowing sphere. It was about the size of a basketball. It shifted colors every few seconds going from green to red to yellow. The light coming off of it wasn't extremely bright, but in the darkness, it stood out clearly.
The sphere was going exactly the same speed as my car. I was driving under the speed limit because of the icy road. I was going about 45 mph. I kept looking over at it and it stayed in the same position relative to my car outside the driver's (sic. passenger's) side window.
The ground dropped off sharply a few feet beyond the guardrail. My first thought was that there must be a parallel road down below and another vehicle that happened to be going the exact same speed as myself had a tall pole attached to it with a weird color changing light on top of it. As strange as that would be it was the only explanation I could…

I was sitting in my seat on the left hand side of the plane looking out of the window when something to my upper left hand side field of vision caught my eye. 
Sitting there, just as plain as day, was an absolutely enormous craft of some kind. It was a dark dull grey in color, disc shaped with a dome on top and underneath. The domes were almost as tall as the craft was wide. I remember thinking that it looked rather “clumsy”. It appeared to be motionless with no apparent lights, exhaust or gasses. Again, I want to emphasize the size of the thing. Allowing for a distance of 3 to 4 miles from us it must have been at least 2 football fields wide and almost the…

Then I opened my window to see better and I cannot hear any helicopter. And the light is way too close not to be able to hear if it was. 
So I keep watching and the light disappears for a moment then reappears a couple hundred yards to the left and it seems closer. Then it just disappears. So I go to sit back down, and as I turn around my Amazon Echo starts listening to me, then says, "Sorry, I don't know that one." Very odd.

summary: Object seen off of U.S. Highway 14  at low altitude moving north.
description:
January 2, 2018. This report is being filed from Rosamond, California.
Daylight conditions: partially cloudy. 
Today at 10:20 AM, while traveling south bound on U.S. Highway 14, approximately between Avenues D and E, an object was spotted at an estimated distance of ¼ mile above the highway. First impressions were that it was a large bird like duck or sea gull. As I kept my attention on the object, it became clear to me that it was not a bird, but perhaps an aircraft. 
Seconds later, the object is now about two hundred feet ahead of my car, and moving alongside the highway about 150 feet parallel to the highway. As the object flies by my right hand view moving straight with a speed less than my 65 MPH, I can now see that it’s an object about fifty feet in altitude.
The object is chrome skinned, appearing smooth, and not a conventional aircraft. I can only estimate that it’s an object about 20 feet in length with an equal height in a pyramid shape. 
No audible sound was heard from this object as it came at the closest position to my car. Highway 14 was unusually heavy with traffic as many are now returning home from the holidays. Others had to have seen this object.

My husband viewed one, and I viewed both. #2 was higher than #1. He was driving and #2 was out of the bright face of the moon and could no longer be seen when he observed #1. 
Once the objects or shadows were out of the bright face of the moon, they were no longer visible. Other people viewed this I am sure, speak up.

summary: A light in the sky that got bigger and brighter without any movement
description:
I was looking up at the night sky and was looking at visible stars. One star (i thought was a star) suddenly got brighter and brighter as if someone was shining a bright light, it also increased in visible size (very slightly). I have seen the ISS on numerous occasions and understand how it gets brighter when above and fades as it goes out of sight, this was different, the bright light remained in a constant position and did not move in any direction. 
The ISS is also currently beneath the continent of Africa, so could not have been this.
The bright light faded and then looked like a normal star in size and brightness momentarily then disappeared completely not moving in any direction.
This was not an aircraft. There was no forward or sideways movement. The night sky at my angle of view was clear without any cloud cover.
The whole viewing lasted only seconds.

description:
Here is the video link:
http://www.king5.com/article/news/local/seattle-rings-in-2018-with-new-years-at-the-needle/281-502828048 
The event occurs at approximately 6.38 seconds into the video. The object appears to be hovering over the Puget Sound on the left side of the screen. It is a rather large object flashing green. It is somewhat erratic in its lateral movement, then it rapidly shoots straight up in the air. Just about that time the videographer cut away, so it was impossible to see where it went.
Object looks to us to be a small quadcopter/drone. PD

summary: 3 Star like crafts in New Years 2018
description:
My husband and I went your to watch fireworks at midnight. Looking up at the sky we saw one light that looked like a star moving quickly. In front of the moon and near the Big Dipper. Then we noticed a star looking craft also moving across. The game together moving around one another then a third craft came. They were definitely moving and joined together to make contact. They remained there for a long time and they got more distant because we could still see them but they were harder to see because they were farther alway. Not a drone. Too high and they looked just like stars.
 One of the first sightings I’ve had.
We assume that they were observing earth during our celebration. Maybe you will see some crafts tonight and I hope others spotted them. They actually may still be up there if you look now near the Big Dipper and moon.

summary: Several orange lights moving slowly, which faded out, one by one.
description:
I was standing outside getting ready to ring a bell as is my New Year's tradition when I spotted three glowing red-orange dots. They were low to the NE, rising slowly and steadily up southwards. The top two made a sharp curve west and faded out. By the time the third, flickering slightly, slowly faded from view, 5 or 6 more in a loose constellation followed it in the same direction, disappearing one by one. A very bright one appeared afterwards, taking the same curved route as the first two. It took nearly 10 minutes for the whole spectacle to play out.
 I'm not sure of the exact number because once I realized they were not helicopters, I was busy trying to get a picture. Afterwards, I thought they might have been fire balloons -- until I saw the one photo that came out.
 Those wild orange swirls are the motions of the orange dots within the second it took to snap the photo. They are NOT the result of camera motion because 1) they are not at all the same, and 2) that bright green squiggle in the lower left is a string of Christmas tree lights across the street, and it's absolutely unblurred and crisp.
 I've enhanced color and contrast to make the trails more visible but that's…
